fields.name: Factory Plan Approval
fields.why_required: Mandatory under Section 6 of the Factories Act 1948 to ensure occupational safety, ventilation, emergency exits, and worker health standards prior to civil construction.
fields.eligibility: Any manufacturing unit employing 10 or more workers with power, or 20 or more without power.
fields.fee_structure: ₹5,000 to ₹25,000 based on installed horsepower and worker strength
fields.renewal_period: One-time approval unless substantial expansion occurs
fields.applicable_sectors: Food Processing, Manufacturing, Automobile, Chemical, Textile, Pharmaceuticals

fields.name: MPCB Consent to Establish (CTE)
fields.why_required: Statutory consent under Water (Prevention & Control of Pollution) Act 1974 and Air Act 1981 before starting civil construction or equipment installation.
fields.eligibility: All industrial units categorized under Red, Orange or Green industrial classifications by CPCB/MPCB.
fields.fee_structure: ₹15,000 to ₹1,00,000 based on Capital Investment (₹5 Cr bracket = ₹25,000)
fields.renewal_period: Valid for 5 years or until commercial commissioning
fields.applicable_sectors: Food Processing, Chemical, Pharmaceuticals, Textile, Manufacturing

fields.name: Industrial Fire Safety NOC
fields.department: MIDC Fire Services / Maharashtra Fire Services
fields.why_required: Mandatory compliance with Maharashtra Fire Prevention and Life Safety Measures Act 2006 to ensure fire hydrant networks, smoke detectors, and emergency evacuation.
fields.eligibility: All commercial and industrial factory buildings exceeding 500 sq. meters built-up area.
fields.fee_structure: ₹10 per sq. meter built-up area fire infrastructure cess
fields.renewal_period: Annual renewal via Form B inspection certificate
fields.applicable_sectors: Food Processing, Manufacturing, Automobile, Chemical, Warehousing

fields.name: HT/LT Industrial Electricity Connection
fields.department: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd. (MSEDCL)
fields.why_required: Sanction of dedicated HT/LT commercial power load for industrial processing machines and continuous factory operations.
fields.eligibility: Any registered enterprise holding valid land title or lease agreement in Maharashtra.
fields.fee_structure: Estimate quotation based on load demand (₹50,000 to ₹3,00,000)
fields.applicable_sectors: Food Processing, Manufacturing, Automobile, Chemical, Textile, IT & Electronics

fields.name: FSSAI State Manufacturing License
fields.why_required: Mandatory licensing under Food Safety and Standards Act 2006 for manufacturing, packing, or storing food items.
fields.eligibility: Agro & Food Processing units with turnover up to ₹20 Crore (State License) or higher (Central License).

fields.name: Factory Operating Licence (Form 4)
fields.why_required: Statutory permit under Section 6 of Factories Act 1948 to commence active manufacturing operations with workforce.
fields.eligibility: Units that have completed civil construction in accordance with approved Factory Plan.
fields.applicable_sectors: Food Processing, Manufacturing, Automobile, Chemical, Textile

fields.name: Steam Boiler & Pipeline Erection Registration
fields.why_required: Registration under Indian Boilers Act 1923 for high-pressure steam vessels used in food sterilization and steam boiling.
fields.eligibility: Manufacturing units operating boilers with capacity exceeding 25 litres.
fields.fee_structure: ₹8,000 to ₹35,000 based on heating surface area

fields.name: Stamp Duty Exemption Certificate (PSI 2019)
fields.why_required: Incentive under Maharashtra Industrial Policy 2019 granting 100% stamp duty waiver on land purchase/lease in MIDC industrial areas (Zone C, D, D+).
fields.eligibility: Eligible MSME and Large units establishing in designated developing talukas of Maharashtra.
fields.applicable_sectors: Food Processing, Manufacturing, Automobile, Textile, Chemical, IT & Electronics

fields.name: Maharashtra Package Scheme of Incentives (PSI 2019 / 2024 Policy)
fields.department: Directorate of Industries, Government of Maharashtra
fields.description: Comprehensive fiscal incentives including Capital Investment Subsidy (up to 50% for Nashik Zone C/D), 100% Stamp Duty Exemption, Electricity Duty Exemption for 7 years, and ₹1.50/unit Power Tariff Subsidy.
fields.eligibility: New Greenfield Units and Substantial Expansion in MSME & Large sectors set up in developing areas (Zones B, C, D, D+). Investment minimum ₹25 Lakhs.
fields.benefits:
• Up to 50% Capital Subsidy on Gross Fixed Capital Investment
• 100% Stamp Duty Exemption during land acquisition
• 7-year Electricity Duty Exemption
• Interest Subsidy @ 5% p.a. on term loan
fields.max_subsidy: Up to ₹1.50 Crore for MSME; higher for Mega units
fields.applicable_districts: All Districts of Maharashtra with enhanced rates for Zone C, D, D+

fields.name: Maharashtra Food Processing Policy Capital Subsidy Scheme
fields.description: Dedicated financial assistance for setting up fruit & vegetable processing, dairy processing, and cold chain preservation facilities near farm clusters like Nashik, Pune, and Nagpur.
fields.eligibility: Enterprises establishing commercial food processing facilities with minimum 50 direct rural employments.
fields.benefits:
• 35% to 50% Capital Subsidy for agro-processing machinery
• Cold chain logistics subsidy up to ₹50 Lakhs
• Quality certification reimbursement (ISO 22000, HACCP)
fields.applicable_districts: All Districts of Maharashtra with enhanced rates for Zone C, D, D+

fields.name: Chief Minister’s Employment Generation Programme (CMEGP)
fields.department: Maharashtra State Khadi & Village Industries Board / Directorate of Industries
fields.description: Flagship government initiative to foster grassroots entrepreneurship and employment generation across semi-urban and rural Maharashtra.
fields.eligibility: Any Indian citizen above 18 years establishing manufacturing (up to ₹50 Lakhs) or service unit (up to ₹20 Lakhs).
fields.benefits:
• 15% to 35% margin money government grant
• Soft loans through nationalized and scheduled banks
• Priority single-window licensing via DICs
fields.max_subsidy: Up to ₹17.50 Lakhs margin money grant
fields.applicable_districts: All Districts of Maharashtra with enhanced rates for Zone C, D, D+

fields.name: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Special Incentive Scheme for SC/ST Entrepreneurs
fields.department: Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Maharashtra
fields.description: Special empowerment package providing preferential land allotment in MIDC, 100% stamp duty waiver, and up to 30% capital grant for affirmative business growth.
fields.eligibility: Enterprises with more than 51% equity held by entrepreneurs from Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes.
fields.benefits:
• 30% Capital Investment Subsidy
• Power tariff subsidy of ₹2.00 per unit for 5 years
• 20% land rebate on MIDC industrial plots
fields.applicable_districts: All Districts of Maharashtra with enhanced rates for Zone C, D, D+

fields.name: Green Industrial Transition & Rooftop Solar Adoption Subsidy
fields.description: Promoting industrial carbon footprint reduction through subsidized rooftop solar installations and energy audit reimbursements.
fields.eligibility: Operational and new manufacturing units establishing captive renewable energy generation above 50 kWp.
fields.benefits:
• Net-metering accelerated grid synchronization
• 20% capital grant on solar installation cost
• 50% reimbursement for BEE-certified energy audit
fields.max_subsidy: Up to ₹25 Lakhs per manufacturing premise
fields.applicable_districts: All Districts of Maharashtra with enhanced rates for Zone C, D, D+
